name: @familyhq/functions
description: Family HQ Cloud Functions (Node 20, 2nd gen, northamerica-northeast1). Workspace is intentionally separated from the SPA so the firebase-functions / firebase-admin SDKs never bloat the client bundle.
_test_writer_note: PR A scope: only test scripts + dependency surface are wired now. The implementer adds build artifacts (functions/lib/) when implementing A1/A2. Keep firebase-functions and firebase-admin OUT of the root package.json — the SPA must not transitively depend on them.
